title: 2 Queen | LQ Goodlettsville | Near Nashville
description:
A two-queen deluxe room with a sofa bed, giving families room to spread out near Nashville. Explore Music City and the Hermitage by day, then cool off by the seasonal outdoor pool.

The space
This listing is for a room within a hotel.

✦ Your room  equipped with complimentary toiletries, high definition 55-inch TV, available with Standard cable.

✦ Cleaning services included in the nightly price.

There are a few additional details to know before you book:

✦ The minimum age required for check-in is 21 years old.

✦ Please ensure you have a valid ID for check-in, as it is mandatory for entry.

Guest access
During your stay, you will have access to the property and amenities according to the following schedule:

✦ Check-in is available from 3:00PM to 2:00AM.

✦ Public or shared fitness center open 24/7, available in the property.

✦ Outdoor shared pool available from May 1 to September 30, opened from 10:00AM to 10:00PM.

✦ Free parking lot – 1 space(s).

Other things to note
There are several additional things to note:

✦ A valid credit or debit card is required for the refundable security deposit and any offline fees displayed upon completing your Airbnb reservation.

✦ Pets are welcome with an additional charge of $25.00 (per night). 2 Cats/Dogs per unit | Up to 75 lbs each

✦ We use multi-unit listings, so rooms are similar but may have small differences.

✦ The maximum number of days that you may book per reservation is only 28 days.

✦ Early check-in and late check-out are subject to availability for a fee.

✦ Free continental breakfast available daily 6:00 AM to 9:00 AM.
